scenario: Evaluate a pull request that adds unnecessary dependencies

code_changes: import { debounce } from 'lodash' // used once, setTimeout works
import moment from 'moment' // used for one date format
import axios from 'axios' // replacing native fetch with wrapper
import { v4 } from 'uuid' // used once, crypto.randomUUID() available

should_reject: moment (Intl.DateTimeFormat or native Date methods suffice)
axios (native fetch is available and standard)
must_not: approve any of the four dependencies
